versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Tire Chain Law Navigator.
- Provides chain law verdicts for US, Canada, and EU-Alps mountain routes based on date, vehicle class, and AWD/4WD status.
- Includes rules for "carry vs must install", exemptions, fine information, and jurisdiction-specific chain law classes (R1/R2/R3, Traction Law, etc.).
- Features chain-up zone finder, sizing and equipment legality guide, and printable dash-card for trip preparation.
- Designed for pre-trip planning to avoid legal issues and ensure compliance on winter mountain roads.
